settings:
# settings for the local cultural planner; the image model settings stay separate
model: qwen2.5:3b
endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat
timeout: 180
keep_alive: 0 # unload after each request to free memory for other stages
options:
  temperature: 0 # use the most likely next text piece
  seed: 42 # helps repeat the same experiment
  num_ctx: 4096 # maximum working space for input and output text
  num_predict: 1024 # maximum generated text pieces; incomplete output is rejected
